title: Material Looks and Feels Like Nonslip Shelf Liner
text:
Material Looks and Feels Like Nonslip Shelf Liner. These ALL-WEATHER PATIO TABLE placemats are made from the same sort of material found in certain rolls of soft, nonslip, "gripper" shelf liner. They're suitable for outdoor patio table use, but not nearly attractive enough for everyday indoor table use. At the price (about $15), I wasn't expecting much, but I was still quite disappointed.

The material is so full of holes, spilled liquids go right through. No easy cleanup with these mats! Also, the rubbery texture of the mat "fabric" is mildly unpleasant to touch. The mats do provide cushioning for ceramic dinnerware placed on hard table surfaces.

What I was looking for, was an inexpensive, protective, wipe-clean placemat for everyday use on a round dining-room table. After I ordered these placemats, I found some suitable rectangular ones in solid vinyl at Bed, Bath and Beyond. I converted the BB&Y mats into wedge-shaped placemats by using ordinary scissors to cut them into shape.

Because of the cheap shelf-liner material, I rate these All-Weather Patio Table placemats at 2 stars ("I don't like it" on the official Amazon scale).

product_metadata.title: All-Weather Patio Table Placemat & Coaster Set of 12 (6 of Each)
description: Unlike cloth, our gripper placemats and coasters won’t budge on slippery surfaces. In fact, the plates, glasses and utensils you place on top won’t shift a smidgeon either. They’re made from no slip rubber-like plastic with the appearances of a natural weave, and are wedge-shaped for efficient use on round tables.
